step1.title: Download CVM Data
step1.description: Downloads DFP (annual) and ITR (quarterly) financial statements from the CVM open data portal.

step2.title: Data Preparation
step2.description: Filters raw data: selects income statement accounts (DRE), keeps only year-end figures (drops prior-year restated rows), and excludes holding entities.

step3.title: DRE Transformation
step3.description: Deduplicates annual (DFP) and quarterly (ITR) filings, prioritizing the most recent restatement. Pivots income statement accounts into columns and computes margin ratios.

dedup_rules_list.description: When both an annual (DFP) and a quarterly (ITR) filing exist for the same period, the annual filing takes priority.
When multiple versions of the same filing exist, only the most recent restatement is kept.
Cumulative year-to-date ITR rows are excluded; only standalone quarterly figures are retained.

step4.title: EBITDA Drivers
step4.description: Calculates derived metrics: Gross Margin, EBIT Margin, COGS/Revenue, and period-over-period changes.
step4.revenue_yoy_desc: Year-over-year change in net revenue. Positive = revenue grew vs prior year.
step4.cogs_yoy_desc: Year-over-year change in cost of goods sold (absolute value). Positive = costs increased vs prior year.
step4.gross_margin_desc: Gross profit as % of revenue = (Revenue − COGS) / Revenue. Measures production efficiency.
step4.ebit_margin_desc: Earnings before interest and taxes as % of revenue. Measures operating profitability before financing costs.
step4.ebitda_margin_desc: EBIT plus depreciation & amortization as % of revenue. Proxy for operating cash generation.
step4.cogs_revenue_desc: Cost of goods sold as % of revenue. Rising values indicate cost pressure or declining pricing power.
step4.sga_revenue_desc: Selling, general & administrative expenses as % of revenue. Measures overhead efficiency.

step5.title: Data Quality Scan
step5.description: Validates computed metrics against sector-specific plausibility bounds. Flags out-of-range values and assigns confidence scores that gate downstream pattern detection.

bounds.rationale: Values outside this range suggest raw data errors or extreme non-recurring items — petrochemical gross margins rarely exceed 80% or fall below -50%.
EBIT below -50% typically indicates large impairments rather than operating losses; above 60% is implausible for asset-heavy industrials.
COGS below 20% of revenue is unrealistic for commodity manufacturers; above 130% flags a data scaling or sign error.
SG&A above 40% of revenue is implausible for industrial companies and likely reflects a misclassified cost line.
